title: Vijay Stambha, Chittorgarh
summary: The Vijay Stambha, or Tower of Victory, stands in the north-east corner of Chittorgarh Fort, Rajasthan. Rana Kumbha built it in 1448 to commemorate his victory over Mahmud Khilji at Sarangpur, with Sutradhar Jaita as chief architect. It has nine storeys and is given as 37 m tall, though the Incredible India page also says 34 m.

uncertainty.note: Both opened pages give 1448; Rajasthan Tourism in search results gives 1440-1448 but was not opened. End is the present.
